_comment: What production scans with, pinned for the accuracy gate (#215). The CI run uses exactly this, run.json records it, and eval.cli gate refuses to compare a run against a baseline recorded under anything else. Keep it in step with Railway: SCAN_PROMPT_VERSION (unset = prompts.DEFAULT_PROMPT_VERSION), GEMINI_MODEL (unset = aiconfig's default) and GEMINI_THINKING_BUDGET (unset = null; on Gemini 3+ null means GEMINI_THINKING_LEVEL, default medium). Model moved to gemini-3.5-flash-lite on 2026-11-03 ahead of Google redirecting gemini-2.5-flash on 2026-12-01; confirm GEMINI_MODEL is unset on Railway. Changing any value means re-recording eval/data/baseline.json in the same PR.
